cases.interpretation_note: Unknown gender/number is not evidence of incompatibility.
No supplied rank witness licenses this forward reference in the bounded prior-reference reader.
Duplicate name is valid context with ambiguity, not an invalid context or first-ID choice.
Repeated deictic forms union alternatives, rather than overwrite the first/last entry.
A generic indefinite subject does not identify the sole contextual man.
Hamza seat distinction is not normalized away to match a context name.
Explicit incompatible internal vowels cannot be ignored as if they were missing marks.
Imperative shape does not prove compliance or distinguish order/request/prayer without a pragmatic premise.
A conditional does not assert either isolated event. Full rule semantics is outside the targeted first discourse frames.
Outer question blocks both positive and negative assertion of the embedded predication.
Whatever supported coordination analysis remains, the explicit first-clause negation must not be stripped. No blanket requirement to negate the second clause.
A mention retains written shapes but supplies no asserted source claim.
Qatr forbids temporal predicate of an entity/essence without the separately licensed interpretation. Do not invent an event/property for the time to qualify.
Compound temporal idafa is outside the declared first scope; it cannot be dropped to admit an unqualified event.
The bounded place rule requires the declared kind=place premise; an unsupported complement is not silently erased.
Past property and unspecified-time property have different query identities.
Restriction is part of the source claim identity and does not negate every other contextual or unknown individual. This case does not forbid a separately proven positive entailment about حازم.
A subordinate causal fragment does not authorize an invented complete causal/implication assertion.
Explicit feminine written return conflicts with the masculine singular relative and named referent; cannot discard the relative clause.

No written return in the declared bounded subject-return reader. Classical hidden/deleted returns may be licensed by other evidence; this expectation is a scope abstention, not a general ungrammaticality claim.
An unlearned predicate family cannot become a grounded semantic predicate from position or the requested answer.
A named subject context is not a lexical predicate policy.
Attested inflection and explicit genitive ending cannot satisfy a simple nominal predicate nominative requirement.
Both QAC person analyses of this written form survive; ت alone is not feminine evidence. No addressee or prior antecedent binds either event.
The two nuns must have separate real source spans inside one reading; root-final ن and retained رفع are not pooled from alternatives.
A deleted marker has no invented nonempty raw span, and no subject individual is supplied by the ending.

This exact first-person host is not one of the full attested daxala suffix cells in QAC. Do not reinterpret the attested second-person دخلتَ or plural دخلتم as this form solely by terminal-letter analogy.
Only one QAC nominal form for this lemma is present. Tanwin and deleted ya shape alone do not establish a complete nominal construction law.
The root is not the semantic predicate identity or a supplied subject. حكيم and other حكم lemmas cannot be collapsed.
The hollow root comes from a matching QAC source reading, not from any internal alif rule.
Compare semantic fields only: every altered corpus has a different source identity. CASE/MOOD are never predictor features or target answers.

Removing the participant premise invalidates old support.
An old حكيم certificate cannot verify against كريم source.
A valid proof for one predicate is not a proof for another question.
Explicit model withdrawal is not omitted/self-replay.
Lexically identical text in another scope has another claim identity.
Byte-identical source text does not retain the prior occurrence/source identity.
A boolean domain rejects integer 1.
An answer label is not a context premise.
Duplicate IDs are invalid; duplicate names under distinct IDs are handled separately as ambiguity.
